| 2. Name items assessed, state findings | ✅ Compliant | All assessed items named and findings stated |
| 3. Quote set-aside items | N/A | No items set aside in this review |
| 4. Smallest corrective action | ✅ Compliant | Implemented recorded standing rule as trigger |

---

### Finding 1: Standing Rule Implemented
The recorded standing rule for ROLLOVER-3 marker processing has been implemented as an active trigger.

### Finding 2: No New Work Items
No new inbound batches, emails, or work items requiring processing were identified.

With the standing rule now armed, subsequent cycles will automatically apply the ROLLOVER-3 processing guidance without being told again.
